title: Bo Kluea salt: a quicker scrape and a prettier street
kaylee: The salt scrape is done in about half the strokes, the painted couple across the road are a cute pony and bear in Tai Lue clothes, a pink Nan scooter waves as it goes by, and the cat is the round ginger cat from the boat trip.
